# Third-party visual assets / 纹理来源与许可

The planetary textures distributed with this project are by **Solar System Scope / INOVE**, licensed under **Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)**. They are separate from the application's MIT-licensed source code.

- Author and original download page: [Solar System Scope](https://www.solarsystemscope.com/textures/)
- License: [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)
- License legal text: [CC BY 4.0 legal code](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode)
- Required attribution: **Planet textures: Solar System Scope / INOVE, CC BY 4.0.**
- Changes made by this project: files renamed only; image pixels are unmodified. Runtime lighting, material rendering, cloud transparency and ring mapping change their displayed appearance.

这些纹理来自 Solar System Scope / INOVE，采用 CC BY 4.0 许可。允许复制、修改及商业使用，分发时须保留作者署名、原始来源及许可证链接，并说明修改。应用代码的 MIT 许可证不替代这些素材的 CC BY 4.0 许可证。

The source provider describes the maps as based on NASA imagery and elevation data. Colors have been adjusted and some unmapped areas have been filled by the provider. They are visual maps, not scientific measurement products or live imagery. Earth clouds, city lights and gas-giant weather are illustrative and do not change with the selected simulation date.

## Included files

All files are in `assets/textures/`. All globe maps are 2048 × 1024 pixels. The RGBA Saturn ring strip is 2048 × 125 pixels; map its horizontal coordinate to ring radius.

## Download provenance

The original provider's binary download host returned HTTP 403 during packaging. Unmodified copies were obtained from the public [TanvirAhmedArnab/SolarSystem source-asset mirror](https://github.com/TanvirAhmedArnab/SolarSystem/tree/main/SourceAssets/ThirdParty/Textures/SolarSystemScope), which preserves the original filenames and [asset attribution](https://github.com/TanvirAhmedArnab/SolarSystem/blob/main/Docs/Legal/ThirdPartyAssets.md). The downloaded bytes use the GitHub LFS media URL prefix `https://media.githubusercontent.com/media/TanvirAhmedArnab/SolarSystem/main/SourceAssets/ThirdParty/Textures/SolarSystemScope/`, followed by the original filename above. Retrieved 2026-10-22.
